quote: Quality Estimation (QE) is the task of predicting the quality of an automatically translated sentence at test time, without the need to rely on reference translations.
Given a source sentence, s and a translated sentence, t, the goal of QE is to learn a regression model, m such that m(s, t) returns a score that represents the quality of the translated sentence.

Following the standard practice used by the QE research community, we measure the performance of a QE model by calculating the Pearson Correlation coefficient of its predicted DA scores and the actual human-annotated DA scores on a test set.
